create_backtranslation_dataset: create a BacktranslationDataset from a target dataset with source and target dictionaries for synthetic data generation
backtranslate_samples: backtranslate a list of samples using a collate function and generation function to produce source-target pairs
set_backtranslation_fn: set the backtranslation function on a BacktranslationDataset instance to enable generation of synthetic source sentences
collate_and_backtranslate: collate and backtranslate a batch of samples through the BacktranslationDataset collater method to generate training pairs
review_backtranslation_dataset: review the BacktranslationDataset class and its collater method to understand how synthetic parallel data is generated
